# ResearchRabbit

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 9 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Interactive citation graph beside a list: node and edge styling, canvas interaction (see graph.md).

Captured 2026-10-04, signed in. Themes: light.

ResearchRabbit is a literature tool built around an interactive citation
graph: a search returns papers as a list beside a map of how they cite each
other. It was read on 2026-10-04, signed in, as the model for the `/learn`
map of concepts. The graph is the point of this reference, and
[graph.md](graph.md) is the document to read first: layout, drawing,
interaction and motion, with every value traced to the app or its code, and a
comparison with the `/learn` map as it is built today.

Pages read: Home, a search's results in split, list and map views (hover on a
node, a list card and each legend chip; a selected node with its detail
panel; zoomed in; every tab of the layout settings; the keyword filter), and a
library collection in list and map views (hover, a dragged node with the
"Positions moved" pill and its Reset menu).

## Typography

13 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Plus Jakarta Sans.

### Fonts (from README.md)

| Family | Weights | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| Plus Jakarta Sans | 200 to 800 | Everything: the interface and the canvas labels (12px, 600 for emphasis, 600 14px selected) |
| IBM Plex Sans | 300, roman and italic | Requested by the page's font link, but no captured rule names it, so nothing on these pages renders in it |

The italic used for journal names and the list total is Plus Jakarta Sans
italic. Both families are open source on
Google Fonts, which the style guide links.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.
